desc: Staged and ready from 2026-07-30: initramfs-dcuart-hidf.cpio.gz (e9fcd3b3, minimal busybox + the CJ-approved a1f4131d blob, nothing auto-opens inputs) + kernel carrying yuka d197cf69 (L2C_ERR fault address printed on SError). The HIDF upload fires on FIRST input-device open, which is why it killed graphical boots at ~1s. Boot this, reach the ttydc0 shell, then trigger deliberately with 'head -c1 /dev/input/event0' while the console captures. Goal: identify whether the crash is an SError (get the fault address) or something else. CJ granted the ticket-126 exception for a1f4131d only, volatile DMA, no flash.
